title: Ek bachi gham ki
body:
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki maari aur raat karbala ki
kano se khoon jaari aur raat karbala ki
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron se hogaya hai chalni pidar ka seena
neendh aa rahi hai isko awaaz de sakina
laashe pade hai saare aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal mein hurr ki bewa aayi hai leke pani
yaad aa rahi hai apne kunbe ki mezbani
ehsaas sharm saari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachi ki bekasi ka ye imtehan kada hai
baba ka jism khoon mein dooba hua pada hai
har lamha dil pa waari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
meinoosiyon ka saaya badta hi jaa raha hai
kya kya khayal dil mein dukhiya ke aa raha hai
honton pa aah o zaari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehmi hui hai bachi aur jal rahe hai qaime
koi nahi jo aake jangal mein hal banaye
abid pa ghash hai taari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe se dil ke upar gham ka pahad toota
maare gaye baradar baba ka saath choota
sehra hai bekharari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ban mein dukha hua dil phir se dukha rahi hai
zainab ke dil ke upar khanjar chala rahi hai
aati hui sawari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek waqt mein akeli kis kis ke paas jaye
kis kis ko de tasalli kis kis ka dil badhaye
kunbe ki zimmedari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab utho sakina jangal mein kho gayi hai
seene pe jaa ke shayad baba ke so gayi hai
hai imtehan bhaari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar kar ke yaad akhtar aansu bahayega dil
irfan ye bata de kaise bhulayega dil
ek maa ki ashk baari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
